neighbours.label: a split piece of an eye word in medical use (oc|ular, ey|el|ids), as opposed to whole words like ' eyebrows' and other body parts
fire: Ophthalmologists treat ocular problems such as cataracts.
Many ocular diseases damage the retina.
The drug has some ocular side effects.
Her eyelids felt heavy after the long drive.
Ocular pressure is measured in this test.
He rubbed his swollen eyelids and sat up.
The cream is not for use on eyelids.
quiet: Dentists treat dental problems such as cavities.
Many skin diseases damage the hair.
The drug has some stomach side effects.
Her shoulders felt heavy after the long drive.
Blood pressure is measured in this test.
He rubbed his sore elbows and sat up.
The cream is not for use on eyebrows.

notes: Tiny corpus max is 34, on 'eb' in 'eyebrows', but whole ' eyebrows' stayed at 0.00 in probes, and it splits only in some contexts.
